text.text:
Compact and Powerful Embedded Computing for Industrial Innovation

The ET876 from IBASE is an industrial-grade thin Mini-ITX motherboard designed for embedded computing applications. It features support for 8th and 9th generation Intel® Core™ processors with LGA1151 socket, offering scalable performance options. With two DDR4 DIMM slots supporting up to 64GB of memory, the motherboard ensures efficient multitasking and data processing capabilities. The ET876 thin Mini-ITX motherboard provides rich connectivity options, including multiple USB ports, LAN, HDMI, and DisplayPort interfaces, enabling versatile peripheral integration. The ET876 motherboard also offers expansion capabilities with PCIe and Mini PCIe slots, accommodating additional hardware components for customized functionality. Engineered for reliability and longevity, it operates within a wide temperature range, making it suitable for diverse industrial environments.

• Support for 8th and 9th generation Intel® Core™ processors
  • Two DDR4 DIMM slots supporting up to 64GB of memory
  • Rich connectivity options including USB, LAN, HDMI, and DisplayPort interfaces
  • Expansion capabilities with PCIe and Mini PCIe slots
  • Wide temperature range operation for reliability in industrial environments
